§6Folkvangr Field§f

§aThe DFC's meltdown event. Annihilates everything in a massive spherical area.§f

A Folkvangr field occurs when the DFC's restriction field hits 0% or heat saturation reaches 100%. The core destabilizes and generates a Sessrumnir sphere that expands rapidly, ignoring blast resistance entirely.

§6Effects§f: Creates a perfectly spherical crater. No radiation is left behind because it's consumed by the reaction. The converted energy anomalously vanishes, and the resulting vacuum sucks in air and loose objects.

§6Causes§f: Stabilizers offline or overwhelmed, too many chained emitters, or component failure during operation.

§6Prevention§f:
§b• Multiple stabilizers§f running with redundancy
§b• Monitor restriction field§f and heat constantly
§b• Install a High Energy Field Jammer§f within 300 blocks
§b• Never exceed heat saturation limits§f

§cWARNING:§f The field destroys blocks in a huge radius with no blast resistance check. It can erase months of building in seconds. Prevention is the only reliable defense.

§ePS:§f A Folkvangr field is the end of your DFC. The core is destroyed regardless of whether a jammer is present.
